name: Wake-on-LAN
creator: Joshua Ferguson
desc: Tap a machine to wake it over the network; see which machines are online.

WOL_HOSTS.label: Machines
WOL_HOSTS.description: Name=MAC@IP entries separated by ';' (IP optional, used for online status). Example: NAS=aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff@192.168.0.10; Desktop=11:22:33:44:55:66@192.168.0.20

WOL_BROADCAST.label: Extra broadcast addresses
WOL_BROADCAST.description: Optional, comma-separated. The global and local-subnet broadcasts are always used.
